user.title: Event Recording Setup
user.description: Configure storage directory and retention budgets for neutral event recording. Zero AI dependencies or camera requirements.

error.invalid_media_root: Choose a dedicated private subdirectory; the configuration root and its parents cannot own recordings.
error.media_dir_exposed: Choose storage outside every shared media directory.

init.title: Event Recording Options
init.description: Manage all recording settings, camera profiles, and the effective configuration. Camera profiles are optional defaults; automations decide when to record.

settings.title: Event Recording Settings

data_description.chunk_seconds: Maximum length of each recording segment; longer windows use multiple segments.
data_description.retention_size_mb: Recordings are pruned when the storage budget is reached.
data_description.min_disk_free_mb: Recording admission fails when free disk space would drop below this floor.

data.go2rtc_password: Password (optional, leave blank to keep saved password)

data_description.go2rtc_base_url: HTTP or HTTPS endpoint of the go2rtc API. The integration does not test or discover it.
data_description.go2rtc_password: The saved password is never shown. Leave blank to keep it, or tick the clear box to remove it.

data_description.max_parallel_resources: Caps how many recordings run at the same time.
data_description.queue_wait_timeout_seconds: How long a queued capture waits before it fails with a timeout.

data_description.enable_auto_association: Groups nearby camera events into incidents. Off by default.

camera_add.title: Add Camera Profile
camera_add.description: Add a camera profile in one step. Leave Source ID and Display Name blank to derive them from the selected camera entity. Timing, provider, and correlation controls are grouped below.

data_description.source_id: Stable identifier used to group this camera's events in the timeline. Derived from the camera entity when left blank.
data_description.label: Name shown in the timeline. Derived from the camera entity when left blank.
data_description.recording_mode: Capture lifecycle: extend (repeated bounded chunks), native_fixed (one clip), native_snapshot (still image), or buffered (Frigate export). go2rtc supports extend and native_fixed only.
data_description.recording_provider: Home Assistant is the default. go2rtc buffers video-only fMP4 fragments for pre-event capture.
data_description.window_seconds: The default duration requested when an automation records this camera.
data_description.max_window_seconds: Longest recording window allowed for this camera.

data_description.lookback_seconds: Best-effort pre-event capture. Cold streams may have no pre-roll.
data_description.chunk_seconds: Maximum length of each recording segment; longer windows use multiple segments.

data.frigate_auth_token: Frigate API Token (optional, leave blank to keep saved token)

data_description.go2rtc_stream: Named stream alias configured in go2rtc. Required when the recording provider is go2rtc.
data_description.frigate_base_url: HTTP or HTTPS base URL of Frigate NVR (for example http://frigate.local:5000).
data_description.frigate_camera_name: Camera identifier defined in Frigate configuration.
data_description.frigate_auth_token: The saved token is never shown. Leave blank to keep it, or tick the clear box to remove it.
data_description.export_delay_seconds: Seconds to wait after event end before requesting the exported clip.

data_description.ownership_group: Optional group identifier for cameras sharing the same physical stream to prevent parallel stream concurrency.
data_description.correlation_group: Groups related cameras for cross-camera association.
data_description.adjacent_zones: Comma-separated zones next to this camera, used for cross-camera hypotheses.
